needs.proposedSignature: TriggerEvent: { on: 'counters-put'; self?: boolean; filter?: Filter; counter?: string; firstEachTurn?: true; controller?: 'you' | 'opponent' }
needs.semantics: 'Whenever one or more counters are put on this creature for the first time each turn, draw a card.' No trigger event fires on counters being added; `addCounters` would emit it, with a per-turn marker on the object for `firstEachTurn` (CR 122.3). Needed inside a `grant-ability` here, so the granted ability's event must be a first-class TriggerEvent.
needs.clause: Creatures you control have "Whenever one or more counters are put on ~ for the first time each turn, draw a card."

needs.semantics: 'Whenever this creature attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on target attacking creature with lesser power.' Everything but the target filter exists. Filter carries only absolute power comparisons; the relative form lives nowhere but combat-restr's `power: 'ge-source'` static, which is not a Filter field and cannot reach a TargetSpec. One Filter flag finishes mentor and every 'with lesser/greater power than' target in the pool.
